arg.name: controller_manager_node
arg.description: The name of the controller_manager node to be used

arg.name: frame_prefix
arg.description: An arbitrary prefix to add to the published tf2 frames. Defaults to the empty string.

arg.name: hardware_namespace
arg.description: The namespace containing the Telemetrix Node and the hardware peripherals

arg.name: ticks_per_rotation
arg.description: Ticks per rotation for the encoders. When set to 0, the encoders are disabled. The slot encoders compatible with the MIRTE Pioneers yellow TT motors have 20 ticks per rotation.

arg.name: max_motor_speed
arg.description: The max motor speed in rad/s. NOTE: This is highly depends on the voltage. 5V Power Bank -> ~2 rot/s (~4pi rad/s). 6V Power Supply -> ~3 rot/s (~6pi rad/s).

let.name: _extra_xacro_args
let.value: hardware_namespace:='$(var hardware_namespace)' ticks_per_rotation:=$(var ticks_per_rotation) max_motor_speed:=$(var max_motor_speed) $(var extra_xacro_args)
